subject: Renewal + Expansion Pricing: volume step-ups, blended rates, add new routes/models
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + pricing qualification follow-up

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of ask
- You’re planning a renewal/expansion for patient-facing summarization and retrieval routes.
- Primary goal: reduce per-token cost while maintaining latency & quality for multiple model routes (gpt-style large and a 7B quantized route).

High-level numbers you shared on the call
- Current run-rate: ~40M tokens/month (primarily internal testing + pilot).
- Q3 ramp target: 200M tokens/month.
- FY28 target: ~1B tokens/year (~>80M tokens/month average, with bursts).

Pricing qualification questions (need confirmation)
1) Can you confirm expected monthly committed volumes by quarter (Q3, Q4, FY28)?
2) Target unit economics: you mentioned a target of $/1M tokens in the $30–$45 range — please confirm a tighter range if possible.
3) Mix of routes/models: what % of traffic will go to the large model vs optimized 7B routes?

What I’ll do next
- Draft a renewal + expansion proposal with step-up tiers and blended rates (targeting your $/1M target) and options for adding new routes/models.
- Include transitional pricing for initial ramp and a committed discounted tier for predictable capacity.
- Attach a short proposal draft for your review by EOD Friday.

Ask from you
- Reply with the confirmed volumes (Q3, Q4, FY28) and an updated target $/1M if the $30–$45 range isn’t final.

Thanks — I’ll hold working sessions with Rafael to map blended rates to your model mix once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Pricing_Proposal_Q2.pdf (summary + pricing table)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-05-06T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + pricing qualification follow-up

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming details below: 

Confirmed volumes (approx):
- Current: 40M tokens/month (pilot/live).
- June/July (Q3 ramp): expect ~150–200M tokens/month as more teams go live.
- Q4: ~350–450M tokens/month (steady state for the year-end).
- FY28: targeting ~1.2B tokens/year (monthly average ~100M, but expect spikes).

Target unit economics:
- We are targeting $35–$45 per 1M tokens across mixed routes. Lower is better, but this is the range the leadership is comfortable with.

Model/route mix (estimate):
- 60% optimized 7B routes (lower-cost, low-latency).
- 40% large model routes for complex summarization.

Procurement note (cc): we’ll need billing cadence and contract term options.

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call if needed.

Samantha
Samantha Lee | Sr. Product Manager | Acme Health
samantha.lee@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal draft: step-ups + blended rates + add-new-routes option

Samantha — based on your confirmed numbers I put together a short draft proposal (high-level below); full PDF attached. Key points:

Proposed structure
- Initial ramp commit (Q3): 3-month ramp commitment for 200M tokens/month effective start of renewal.
- Tiered step-ups (post-commit):
  - Tier A: 0–199M tokens/month: $75 per 1M tokens (on-demand/hosted baseline)
  - Tier B: 200–499M tokens/month: $45 per 1M tokens (committed reserved blended)
  - Tier C: 500M+ tokens/month: $30 per 1M tokens (high-volume blended)

Blended example (mixed routes)
- Using your 60/40 split (60% 7B, 40% large): we estimate a blended price around $38–$42 per 1M at 350M/month. Exact blended depends on model routing % and quantization profile.

Adding new routes/models
- New routes (additional model variants) can be added under the same agreement.
- If a new high-cost model is added (e.g., larger >x params), we’ll model an incremental surcharge for those tokens, but they count toward the same step-up tiers for volume discounts.

Contract terms & billing
- Suggested term: 12 months with quarterly true-ups for overages/step-ups.
- Billing: monthly invoicing with net-30; invoice will include blended effective $/1M and token consumption.

Next steps
1) Rafael and I can run a blended-rate sensitivity table (by model mix) — target to share Wed.
2) If this looks good, I’ll convert to a formal SOW + pricing schedule and share for procurement.

Attachment: Redwood_Pricing_Proposal_Q2.pdf (tables + blended examples)

Let me know any changes or if procurement wants an alternate billing cadence.

Best,
Marissa

2) Billing cadence — we typically prefer monthly invoicing with quarterly reconciliation. Confirmed.
3) Data controls / compliance evidence — please include SOC2 report, encryption at rest docs, and audit log availability.
4) Can you provide a sample invoice showing blended math and a DocuSign-ready SOW?

Thanks — we’ll aim to review once we have the SOW + SOC2 package.

- Billing cadence: monthly invoicing with quarterly true-up works.

- Invoice example & SOW: will include a sample invoice page showing blended calculations and a DocuSign-ready SOW link.

Next steps (timeline)

Marissa
